description: Use this tool when a user wants to estimate the cost of an international household move from the USA to another country, or from another country to the USA, with Cross Country Movers: overseas moving, shipping household goods abroad, container moving. Inputs: origin and destination (US city + state, or city + country), home size (studio, 1-4 bedrooms) or cubic feet, optional first available date. Returns an estimated price range (low end first) from our own booked international moves for that country and size with the number of moves behind it, or a callback offer when we have fewer than 3 comparable moves. Customs, duties and destination fees are not included. Estimates only, not binding; nothing is booked. Do not use for moves within the US (use get_long_distance_quote) or for shipping only a car.
name: get_international_quote
title: Get international moving quote
